headline: Oil-war shock and rate-hike binary have stretched yield-sensitive sectors to extreme oversold and energy/defense to overbought — PPI today and CPI tomorrow are the reversion trigger to watch.

US/Iran escalation is creating the most compressed oversold extremes in bonds, industrials & rate-sensitives — while oil ETFs sit at multi-year overbought highs; the reversion trade is the rate-fear unwind, not the energy trade.
Tech & industrials deeply oversold on rate-hike rotation; energy overbought on Iran fear premium — VIX calm at 15.5, no vol-spike setup active.
Energy/defense overbought on Iran war premium while airlines, tech, and small-caps are oversold — NFP at 8:30 AM ET is today's binary that could resolve both sides.
Semis washed out (AMAT RSI 18, XLI RSI 16) while oil/defense overbought on Iran war — FOMC Sep 15–16 is the landmine for both sides.
